title.description: The title (Mr, Ms etc.) to use when communicating with the customer.

first_name.description: The forename (first name) of the customer.

last_name.description: The last name (surname, family name) of the customer.

dob.description: Date of birth must be in the past and after 1900

sex.description: The gender (sex) of the customer. Currently only supports M and F.

postcode.description: Must be a valid UK postcode (e.g. SW1A 2AA)

pep.description: Flag showing whether the director is a politically exposed person (PEP).

is_resident.description: Indicates whether the customer is a resident.

is_sanctioned.description: Indicates whether the customer is on a sanctions list.

verification_method.description: The method used to verify the customer.

land_line.description: UK landline must start +44 followed by 10 digits

mobile_number.description: UK mobile must start +447 followed by 9 digits
